task_prompt: A scene contains 10 shapes of various types (rectangles, ellipses, polygons) scattered across the canvas. 5 are red and 5 are blue. The agent must delete all 5 red shapes and leave all 5 blue shapes intact.

text: I'll help you delete all the red shapes while leaving the blue shapes intact. Let me start by taking a screenshot to see the current state of the canvas.

I can see the canvas with a scene containing shapes. I can see:
- A red rectangle in the center-upper area
- A red circle (ellipse) on the right side (partially visible)
- A blue shape at the bottom (partially visible)

However, I can only see part of the canvas. Let me scroll or adjust the view to see all 10 shapes. First, let me click on the "scene" layer to expand it and see all the shapes in the layers panel.
Good! I've selected the scene layer. Now I need to expand it to see all the individual shapes. Let me click on the arrow next to "scene" to expand and see the child elements.

The scene layer didn't expand. Let me try a different approach. I'll zoom out or pan the canvas to see all the shapes. First, let me try to zoom out to see the entire canvas with all 10 shapes. I'll use the zoom control or try to fit the canvas to view.

The view hasn't changed much. Let me click somewhere in the canvas area first to deselect the current selection, then I'll try to expand the scene layer properly. Let me try double-clicking on the "scene" text to expand it.

I notice there's a small arrow icon next to "scene" in the layers panel. Let me click directly on that arrow to expand the layer and see all child shapes. The arrow should be just to the left of the folder icon.

Perfect! Now I can see all 10 shapes in the layers panel:
- 5 blue shapes: blue_05, blue_04, blue_03, blue_02, blue_01
- 5 red shapes: red_05, red_04, red_03, red_02, red_01

I need to delete all 5 red shapes. I'll start by selecting the first red shape (red_01) and then I'll delete them one by one, or I can select multiple red shapes at once using Ctrl+Click. Let me select all the red shapes first. I'll click on red_01, then hold Ctrl and click on the other red shapes.
Good! I've selected red_01 (shown highlighted in the layers panel and selected on canvas with the blue handles). Now I'll hold Ctrl and click on the other red shapes to select them all at once.

I see that I've selected red_02. It seems the previous selection was replaced rather than added to. Let me try again, making sure to hold Ctrl properly. First, let me click on red_01 again, then Ctrl+click on the remaining red shapes.
Good, red_01 is selected. Now let me hold Shift (not Ctrl) to select multiple items in a list, and click on red_02, then continue with the other red shapes.

I see that Shift+click also just selected red_02. Let me try a different approach - I'll select them one at a time and delete them individually. Let me start with red_01 and delete it using the Delete key.
Good! red_01 is selected. Now I'll delete it by pressing the Delete key.
Excellent! red_01 has been deleted successfully. I can see in the layers panel that red_01 is no longer there. Now I have 4 more red shapes to delete. Let me continue with red_02.
Good! red_02 is now selected (I can see it highlighted in the layers panel and selected on the canvas - it's a red circle on the right side). Now I'll delete it.

Perfect! red_02 has been deleted. I can see in the layers panel that red_02 is gone, and the red circle is no longer visible on the canvas. Now I have 3 more red shapes to delete: red_03, red_04, and red_05. Let me continue with red_03.

Good! red_03 is now selected (highlighted in the layers panel). I can see it's a red polygon (count: 3, which means a triangle). The shape is currently off the visible canvas area (position shows 90, -250). Now I'll delete it.
Excellent! red_03 has been deleted. I can see in the layers panel that red_03 is gone. Now I have 2 more red shapes to delete: red_04 and red_05. Let me continue with red_04.

Perfect! red_04 is now selected (highlighted in the layers panel). I can see it's a red rectangle with dimensions 110x80 at position 375, 100. The shape appears to be off the visible canvas area or not fully visible in the current view. Now I'll delete it.
Excellent! red_04 has been deleted successfully. I can see in the layers panel that red_04 is no longer there. Now I have just 1 more red shape to delete: red_05. Let me select and delete it.

Perfect! red_05 is now selected (highlighted in the layers panel). I can see it's a red circle/ellipse with dimensions 100x100 at position -330, 190. The shape is positioned off the visible canvas area to the left. Now I'll delete this last red shape.

Perfect! I have successfully completed the task. All 5 red shapes have been deleted from the canvas. Looking at the layers panel, I can now see that only the 5 blue shapes remain:

- blue_05
- blue_04
- blue_03
- blue_02
- blue_01

All the red shapes (red_01, red_02, red_03, red_04, and red_05) have been successfully deleted, and all blue shapes are intact. The task is complete!
